# Acme Platform

Acme synchronises records between operational systems and your data warehouse. Connections are configured once and run on a schedule you choose.

## Connections

A connection pairs a source system with a destination. Acme handles authentication, schema mapping and delivery.

## Monitoring

Every sync run is recorded with its row counts and duration. Failures raise an alert to the workspace owners.

## Governance

Workspace owners control who can create connections and who can view synced data.
